lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy2V8O18 (reduced formula DyV4O9) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies vanadium centers as octahedral, coordinated by six oxygen neighbors, while dysprosium centers show eight geometric oxygen neighbors. The same analysis reports corner- and edge-sharing between V-centered octahedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Dy- and V-centered polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
